root_cause: The test runs an LSTM layer with dropout/recurrent_dropout enabled (dropouts=(0.1, 0.3)). Keras/TensorFlow applies dropout masks using its own RNG at inference/training time inside the reference computation path exercised by this test, while OpenVINO's CPU LSTM kernel evaluates deterministically without that stochastic masking semantics being bit-exact-replicated. The resulting outputs differ by a small but assertion-breaking margin (~0.001-0.09 in several cells). This is a long-known, previously investigated recurring flaky test unrelated to the current PR's GPU grid_sample changes.
reproduction_steps: Run locally: pytest tests/layer_tests/tensorflow2_keras_tests/test_tf2_keras_lstm.py::TestKerasLSTM::test_keras_lstm_flags_float32 -k 'dropouts' --device CPU. Reproduction may require several runs due to flakiness tied to dropout RNG seeding.
recommended_actions: Mark this specific LSTM dropout parametrization as xfail/skip with a tracking ticket, or increase the comparison tolerance for dropout-enabled LSTM cases, since exact bit-for-bit reproduction of TF's internal dropout RNG is not guaranteed by OpenVINO
File (or update) a ticket to investigate whether OpenVINO's LSTM CPU kernel's accuracy can be tightened, or whether the test itself should seed/disable dropout for deterministic comparison
Since this is unrelated to the PR's GPU grid_sample changes, re-run only the failed TensorFlow Layer Tests job to confirm the PR change is unaffected
prevention_strategies: Add an explicit tolerance override or disable dropout determinism dependency in test_tf2_keras_lstm.py for parametrizations combining dropout/recurrent_dropout; track recurring flaky LSTM dropout failures and prioritize a fix given 9+ occurrences across months.
